name: Himeno Hitomi
source:
The homeroom teacher for Kazuki, Chitose, and Kei, and the teacher in charge of classical Japanese literature.

With her striking looks, voluptuous figure, alluring charm, and sharp demeanor, she is particularly popular among the male students.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
